risks.description: VTS gives no improvement once the voice activity detector is used -- the combined result is not better than the result without VTS at all

open_questions.description: How much of VTS's lack of effect is down to this particular implementation and tuning, and how much is intrinsic to the method
Whether the noise estimation needs standardising, since the things being tested each use a different one

notes: No actions, and this case is a good test of that. mn052 says 'I may just use one of those Carlos filters' (seg-0002) and 'maybe I'll just go into that also' (seg-0008) -- hedged intent in a status round, not commitment, so neither is an action under the acceptance rule. 'I'm in the process of building up that stuff' (seg-0015) describes work already underway rather than work taken on here. A status update reads like a list of actions and mostly is not one.
